title: Doers of the Word
question: What does James say happens when hearing never becomes doing?
blurb: A mirror, a forgetful glance, and a warning. Follow the picture James draws.

nodes.content: What does James say happens when hearing never becomes doing?

nodes.verseText: Be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Otherwise, you are deceiving yourselves.
For anyone who hears the word but does not carry it out is like a man who looks at his face in a mirror,
But the one who looks intently into the perfect law of freedom, and continues to do so—not being a forgetful hearer, but an effective doer—he will be blessed in what he does.
Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.
Why do you call Me ‘Lord, Lord,’ but do not do what I say?
